title.narrative: Foreign Debt Front Office Capacity Building

description.narrative: The main objective is to support the further development towards sound public debt management practices in Turkey by focusing on capacity building in the front office function for external borrowing. The activities funded under this grant will be targeted: (i) at building an effective organization of the front office, (ii) addressing training needs in the financial and legal area, and (iii) supporting the development of tools that can help ensure that the most cost-risk effective borrowing alternatives are chosen. A specific area of focus is the preparation of procedures manuals and a Code of Conduct to reduce operational risks. The activities will be complimentary to the activities under the existing IDF Grant for Institution Building for Efficient Public Liability Management that focuses on the middle office function, i.e. strategy development and risk analysis. A number of activities targeted at developing capacity in the front office function for external debt are outlined below. The activities have been divided into three main components: (i) governance and management of operational risks; (ii) training; and (iii) IT related. The proposed activities will be supported by a combination of external consultants working with the front office team in Ankara, study tours, targeted training sessions, and IT support in close coordination with the IT Department of the Undersecretariat of the Treasury. TF057376 The objective of the Project is to support the Recipient in its efforts to develop sound public debt management practices by building capacity for foreign debt management in the Undersecretary of Treasury's front office. The Project objectives consists of the following two (2)parts: Strengthening Financial Comparative Analysis Capacity at the General Directorate of Foreign Economic Relations (GDFER) so as to utlize tailor-made software program for financial cost comparisons and related software program and finance training. Train GDFER staff so as to successfully utlize a financial analysis framework and software for project finance to determine the financial viability for project implementing agencies.
